title: Mapping Copilot: the AI-powered mapping assistant, its prerequisites, supported entities, limits and privacy terms

cop-purpose.statement: Mapping Copilot is an AI-powered assistant that recommends mappings and generates mapping logic including Python scripts, and is described as especially useful for unfamiliar schemas such as AnySource and integrations without default mappings.

quotes: Mapping Copilot is an AI-powered assistant within the Agentic Security Operations Platform
This is especially useful when the source schema is unfamiliar, which is common with organization-specific proprietary sources (i.e., AnySource) and integrations that do not include default mappings.
generate mapping logic, including Python scripts
provides intelligent, context-aware recommendations for mapping third-party source data to the SecOps data model

cop-prereq.statement: Mapping Copilot needs at least one successful source run within the last 90 days and a role with Read and Edit permissions under the Platform - Data Source Mapping resource; account admins can remove access by turning off AI capabilities in Account Settings.

quotes: You have set up a data source and completed at least one successful run within the last 90 days.
Your assigned role must include the Read and Edit permissions under the Platform - Data Source Mapping resource.
Account admins can remove access to Mapping Copilot by turning off AI capabilities in Account Settings.

cop-entities.statement: Mapping Copilot suggests mappings for Assets, Findings, Components, Org Entities and Global Vulnerabilities, offers only early-stage support for Alerts, IoC and MITRE, and does not support mapping to custom entities.

quotes: Simplifies the mapping of Components, Org Entities, and Global Vulnerabilities.
Early-stage support is available for Alerts, IoC, and MITRE.
Mapping to custom entities is not currently supported.
Assets: Identifies cloud resources, host machines, and device metadata to recommend mappings.
Findings: Suggests mappings for security vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance gaps

cop-no-explode.statement: Mapping Copilot does not currently support configuring explode for array fields; this must be done manually in the mapping editor.

quotes: Mapping Copilot does not currently support configuring explode for array fields. If your mapping requires exploding an array, configure it manually in the mapping editor.

cop-initial-analysis.statement: Mapping Copilot first analyzes the source file for context, data types and statistics, which can take a few minutes depending on file size, and prompts cannot be sent until it finishes.

quotes: The system performs an initial analysis of the source file to extract context, data types, and statistics. This can take a few minutes depending on the file size. You cannot send prompts until this analysis is finished.

cop-apply-append.statement: Copilot suggestions are inserted as editable drafts using Apply, which overwrites the current mapping configuration, or Append, which adds mappings without altering existing ones; suggested connections are marked with an AI icon.

quotes: Apply: Overwrite your current mapping configuration with Mapping Copilot's suggestions.
Append: Add the new mappings to your workspace without altering existing configurations.
Mappings suggested by Mapping Copilot are marked with an AI icon.

cop-not-final.statement: Mapping Copilot provides guidance only and does not verify end-to-end correctness or downstream behavior, so suggestions must be tested before saving and the source rerun afterward.

quotes: Mapping Copilot provides guidance only and cannot be relied on as a final mapping configuration.
Mapping Copilot does not verify end-to-end correctness or downstream behavior
Make sure to thoroughly test suggestions in your environment before saving them.
After saving the mapping, run the source again and verify the results in your data and downstream workflows.

cop-privacy.statement: Data shared with Mapping Copilot is not transmitted to external third parties, and use of the AI-powered features is optional and controlled by admin opt-in.

quotes: Mapping Copilot operates within Zscaler services, and data shared with it is not transmitted to external third parties.
Use of AI-powered features in the Agentic SecOps Platform is optional. Availability is controlled via admin opt-in in your account.
